# xcsh_infraprotect_synchronize_configuration (Action)

Resource creation operation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# InfraprotectSynchronizeConfiguration Action Example

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.14"

  required_providers {
    xcsh = {
      source  = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

# The API accepts this upgrade request immediately; convergence is asynchronous.
# This action does not reconcile a site's pinned software_settings.
action "xcsh_infraprotect_synchronize_configuration" "example" {
  config {
    namespace = "example-value"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Namespace Namespace in which the config synchronization is scoped.
